flowAuditEvidence.action: Admin setups product in database catalog
flowAuditEvidence.expected: Product "prod-master-1791709090269" created with stock = 25 and price = ₹1499
flowAuditEvidence.dbResult: Atlas Document ID: prod-master-1791709090269, stockCount: 25, price: ₹1499
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Product rendered in Storefront Catalog and Search Index

flowAuditEvidence.action: New Customer registers account on website
flowAuditEvidence.expected: HTTP 201 Created, JWT token issued, user record created in MongoDB Atlas with hashed password
flowAuditEvidence.dbResult: Atlas User found: 6acb4fa24c98c025e9749669 | Password is bcrypt hash: undefined

flowAuditEvidence.expected: HTTP 200 OK, authentication token generated and session cookie set
flowAuditEvidence.dbResult: User credentials validated against Atlas bcrypt hash without plaintext disclosure
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Navbar updates to display customer name and profile link

flowAuditEvidence.action: Customer adds 2 units of product to cart
flowAuditEvidence.expected: HTTP 200 OK, cart persisted in Atlas under verified customer ID
flowAuditEvidence.dbResult: Atlas Cart items: 1 | Item 0 productId: prod-master-1791709090269 | qty: 2
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Floating Cart Bar updates count badge to 2

flowAuditEvidence.action: Customer initiates Checkout with Anti-Tampering Test (Client price ₹1 ignored)
flowAuditEvidence.expected: HTTP 201 Created, Total strictly computed from Atlas DB (₹1499 * 2 = ₹2998)
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Order confirmation modal triggers with summary and order number

flowAuditEvidence.action: Database Inspection: Order initial status & Inventory Reservation Verification
flowAuditEvidence.expected: Order in status 'pending', inventory reserved/deducted at 23 to prevent overselling
flowAuditEvidence.dbResult: Atlas Order: #SE0914332365 | status: 'pending' | inventoryDeducted: true | Product stockCount: 23
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Customer cart emptied, order placed in Pending Orders queue

flowAuditEvidence.action: Customer navigates to Profile / "My Orders" tab
flowAuditEvidence.expected: HTTP 200 OK, customer order history contains the newly placed order with status "Pending"
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Profile page renders Order Card with status badge 'Pending' and amount ₹2998

flowAuditEvidence.action: Admin logs into Admin Dashboard Portal
flowAuditEvidence.expected: HTTP 200 OK, admin_token JWT issued with role="admin", HttpOnly cookie set
flowAuditEvidence.dbResult: Admin account verified against salted bcrypt hash and master env configuration
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Admin dashboard unlocked with Order, Inventory, Product tabs visible

flowAuditEvidence.action: Admin reviews incoming orders in Order Management table
flowAuditEvidence.expected: HTTP 200 OK, newly placed customer order is visible with customer details and pending status
flowAuditEvidence.dbResult: Admin retrieves same Atlas record: #SE0914332365 | Customer: Master QA Customer
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Order table renders new row with badge "Pending", Customer Name, Phone, and Action buttons

flowAuditEvidence.action: Admin confirms and accepts order (Status advances to accepted, no double deduction)
flowAuditEvidence.expected: HTTP 200 OK, Order status advances to 'accepted', Product stock preserved at 23
flowAuditEvidence.dbResult: Atlas Order status: 'accepted' | Atlas Product stockCount: 23 (Expected: 23)
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Admin dashboard updates row status badge to "Accepted" with toast confirmation

flowAuditEvidence.action: Security Guard: Attempt duplicate order acceptance
flowAuditEvidence.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, duplicate acceptance rejected, inventory remains unchanged at 23
flowAuditEvidence.apiResult: HTTP 400 | Error: "Order "#SE0914332365" is not in pending status (current status: "accepted") and cannot be accepted"
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: UI handles duplicate safely without double deduction

flowAuditEvidence.action: Admin advances order through fulfillment pipeline to "delivered"
flowAuditEvidence.expected: HTTP 200 OK, Order status advances to "delivered", sellerNotes saved in database
flowAuditEvidence.dbResult: Atlas Order: #SE0914332365 | status: 'delivered' | sellerNotes: "Dispatched via BlueDart AWB#88776655. Delivered successfully."
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Admin order table updates status to "Delivered"

flowAuditEvidence.action: Customer refreshes "My Orders" to inspect updated status
flowAuditEvidence.expected: HTTP 200 OK, customer sees status updated to "delivered" with seller tracking notes
flowAuditEvidence.dbResult: Matches Atlas delivery timestamp and status
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Customer UI displays green "Delivered" timeline step with delivery confirmation

flowAuditEvidence.action: Post-Audit Cleanliness: Remove test order, customer, and product
flowAuditEvidence.expected: Zero orphaned records in MongoDB Atlas, test documents cleanly removed
flowAuditEvidence.dbResult: Product removed: true | Order removed: true | User removed: true
flowAuditEvidence.frontendResult: Storefront returns to clean initial catalog state
